migrapilot.brainUrl.description: Base URL for the MigraPilot brain service.

migrapilot.transcribeUrl.description: Local speech-to-text endpoint used by the chat mic. Audio recorded in the chat panel is relayed through the extension host to this URL (keeps voice private and on-device).

migrapilot.memoryMode.markdownDescription: Server-side conversation memory. `off` = stateless turns, nothing retained. `session` = the engine remembers the conversation while it runs (default). `durable` = the engine persists the conversation. History lives in the MigraAI Engine, scoped to this workspace — the extension only carries a conversation id.

migrapilot.autoStartBrain.description: In local-brain mode, attempt to auto-start the local brain service when it is unavailable (requires migrapilot.brainAutoStartCommand). Never affects pilot-api.

migrapilot.autoApplyChangeset.markdownDescription: Auto-approve build changes. When ON, a changeset the workspace engineer proposes is applied to your workspace immediately, with no Apply/Review prompt (an auto-accept / 'YOLO' mode, like Cursor's). When OFF (default), you review and click Apply first. Changes are still applied through the engine's approval boundary (atomic, rollback-on-failure) and a notification reports what was written. Only affects the LOCAL workspace engineer — never production.

migrapilot.enableWorkspaceAgent.markdownDescription: Enable the local tool-capable workspace engineer for ordinary chat turns. Disabled by default during the controlled restart: ordinary chat is tool-free and uses `/api/ai/chat`. Explicit agent commands remain separate. Do not enable until tool approval and command-execution policies pass their enterprise safety gates.

migrapilot.brainAutoStartCommand.markdownDescription: argv used to launch the local brain-service when auto-starting (e.g. `["node", "/path/to/apps/brain-service/dist/src/server.js"]`). Empty disables spawning — the extension will still adopt an already-running brain but won't start one.

migrapilot.mode.markdownDescription: Backend mode. `local-brain` = local brain-service (default). `remote-pilot` = pilot-api (opt-in; requires a token and reachable service). `auto` = use pilot-api when ready+authorized, otherwise local. Legacy values map conservatively so remote stays opt-in: `offline`/`hybrid` → local-brain, `cloud` → remote-pilot.

migrapilot.pilotApiUrl.description: Base URL for the MigraPilot pilot-api service (used in remote-pilot / auto modes).

migrapilot.pilotApiAuthMode.description: Authentication for pilot-api. 'bearer' sends the token from SecretStorage (set via 'MigraPilot: Set Pilot Service Token'). 'none' is for a local dev pilot-api with auth disabled.

migrapilot.pilotApiToken.markdownDescription: **Discouraged.** Non-secret fallback token, used ONLY when SecretStorage is empty (headless/dev). Prefer the 'MigraPilot: Set Pilot Service Token' command, which stores the token in SecretStorage and never writes it to settings.

migrapilot.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long MigraPilot waits WITHOUT PROGRESS on a streaming request before giving up (ms). This is patience for silence, not a total budget: every token and every keepalive resets it, so a long answer that is still arriving is never cut off. Raised from 30s because a local model can spend longer than that on prefill before its first token.

migrapilot.maxContextChunks.description: Maximum retrieved chunks to include in context.

migrapilot.enableTelemetry.description: Enable local telemetry for MigraPilot requests.

migrapilot.enableClassicViews.markdownDescription:
**Developer only.** Restore the superseded *Chat (Classic)*, *Agent Mode (Classic)* and *MigraAI Workspace (Classic)* sidebar views.

The canonical MigraPilot interface is the **Command Center** (`MigraPilot: Open Command Center`), which owns chat, governed Agent Mode approval, run evidence, workspace context and the MigraAI Workspace lifecycle in one governed surface. The classic views are retained only for migration verification and are hidden by default so there is exactly one chat composer, one Agent Mode approval path, one run-history surface and one workspace lifecycle surface.

Enabling this does NOT widen any permission: the classic views use the same server-owned proposal + one-time approval boundary and the same evidence-only history.

migrapilot.capabilityContractPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the capability contract **published by MigraAI-Brain** (`capabilities.json`). Leave empty to disable capability resolution; MigraPilot then reports qualified intelligence as UNAVAILABLE and refuses to substitute a model. Never point this at MigraAI-Engineer: Engineer is a build-time component and is absent at runtime.

migrapilot.developerMode.description: Show MigraPilot engineering surfaces: the Agent Workspace, Audit Trail and MigraAI Workspace tabs, service and model diagnostics, and the model-routing and evidence-source selectors. Off by default — the normal interface is the coding assistant, not the console. Nothing is disabled by leaving this off.

migrapilot.brainTimeoutMs.description: Hard ceiling for one non-streaming Brain request (ms), such as Explain Code or Fix Problems. These have no tokens to prove liveness, so the only bound is a total budget — and the previous undeclared 30s default made those commands impossible to complete against a local model. Progress is shown and can be cancelled, so a long wait is visible and interruptible. Deliberately LARGER than the Brain and provider budgets so the layer closest to the work is the one that names the failure.

migrapilot.brainConnectionTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the Brain health probe (ms). Reachability only — never generation.
